svg.text: Study009: componentwise coarser precision is not isolated one-code noise
Frozen deployed packet -> row-scaled signed8 approximation -> unchanged integer neural forward
Four single-component scopes, six variants each: 24 fixed specifications. No escalation, training or deployment.
A Full legal-set changes and actual raw-wrapper outcomes
Scope set /627 bad move /627 raw set /4520 raw bad /4520 raw empty / nonoptimal
query 1 0 8 0 0 / 0
router 1 0 8 4 0 / 4
B Whole-row representation change
Codes -127..127; -128 unused. Round half away.
Smallest k fits row; exponent becomes e+k.
All biases unchanged. Clipping = 0 in every scope.
64 / 64 / 31 / 575 effective scalars changed.
Prior008: 76 isolated +/-1 probes; 0 legal-set changes.
C Restore baseline routes AND gates
Readout: 12 -> 8 canonical move failures.
5 rescued, 1 newly damaged; not a universal rescue.
Raw: 91 -> 65 failures; canonical counts are not x8.
Merged restoration: all final vectors exact.
Matched self controls: all-stage identity, 8/8.
Static parameter conversion and dynamic integer responses are different evidence surfaces.
>=0 is membership, not confidence; wrong full sets can hide behind correct canonical chosen moves.
Host-only replay of original-target fixtures. All boards previously trained/audited; folds are probe confirmation.
NOT a verified reproduction of historical float-master INT8 exports. No C64 timing or deployment claim.
